name: VNV Global AB (publ)
summary: VNV Global AB (publ) formerly known as Vostok New Ventures Ltd., is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in growth capital, buyout investments, incubation, seed/startup, early venture, mid venture, late venture. It prefers to invest globally including Africa / Middle East, European Emerging Markets, Latin America and Caribbean, United States and Canada except China in online marketplaces, consumer-focused and business 2 business companies. It usually seeks investments where it can become a significant minority shareholder and actively manage the investment through board representation. The firm prefers to invest in unlisted companies.
